about: The flags that are signals and are nobody's: each a file of Wikimedia Commons, named by hand. The workflow "Traer datos" brings them (flags-signals) and scripts/data/flags.mjs gives them these names. group: sea (the International Code of Signals), race (motor racing) or other; means: what the flag says when it is flown alone, where it says something.
